title: Parameter-Controlled Regime Transitions in Energy-Flow Cosmology: Cross-Sector Consistency Between Lensing and Background Observables
abstract: Reports controlled scans of the sealed EFC lensing engine showing that the kinetic stiffness K0 dominantly sets the redshift of the predicted sign-changing Σeff(z) crossover, while amplitude parameters have minor impact. Documents cross-sector consistency (µ < 1) between sealed lensing and growth sectors, establishes robustness to power-spectrum choice, and pre-registers joint falsification tests for Euclid DR1 and DESI DR2.
